title: Strange Neighbors
summary: Sal moves into Addison Apartments and meets Larry while a murder investigation unfolds next door.
imageAlt: Charley Mansfield in Sally Face Episode One Strange Neighbors
overview: Episode One introduces Sal Fisher just after he and his father move into room 402 of Addison Apartments. The building looks ordinary from the street, but every floor holds a strange tenant, a locked door, or a story that does not quite add up. A police officer outside room 403 confirms that Sal has arrived in the middle of an active murder investigation.

The chapter is compact, but it establishes the habits that matter throughout Sally Face: inspect backgrounds, revisit characters after every discovery, and use the Gear Boy when it begins to react. Optional conversations with Larry and Lisa also unlock achievements and explain why the apartments have such a disturbing reputation.

walkthrough.title: Complete the dream and enter 5364
walkthrough.body: Answer the phone, switch on the light, move the cabinet, and inspect the key for the first digit. Follow the doors that spell DOG. The four clues appear on the key, the corridor wall, the tree above the dog, and the grave wall. Enter 5364 at the final keypad; using the correct code is required for the Gear Boy achievement path.
walkthrough.tip: Write down 5364. The same four digits return as part of a late-game code.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of the Episode One dream-tree scene

walkthrough.title: Search room 402 and meet the neighbors
walkthrough.body: Move the furniture in Sal's bedroom to collect the Gear Boy, then take the batteries from the grocery bags in the kitchen. Speak with the officer at 403, Lisa on the third floor, Charley in 204, Mr. Addison in 103, and the detective near the lobby. Ask Lisa about things to do for fun to receive basement access.
walkthrough.tip: Exhaust dialogue choices. Several Episode One achievements depend on conversations that look optional.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal inside room 402 with Henry and Gizmo

walkthrough.title: Meet Larry and investigate room 403
walkthrough.body: Collect the game cartridge from the basement Lost and Found, then enter apartment 1B and talk to Larry. Follow his plan to inspect the murder scene in 403. Examine the nightstand, chalk outline, and Glitter Pony evidence before reporting back. Listen to the Sanity's Fall track whenever Larry offers it.
walkthrough.tip: Check Larry's kitchen and the boarded area on floor five for two of The Unknown sightings.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal meeting Larry in apartment 1B

walkthrough.title: Use the tea and reveal Charley's secret
walkthrough.body: Get Addison tea, then choose either the sleeping aid or old laxative route. Give the prepared tea to Charley so you can search his collection and recover the decisive piece of evidence. Finish any Gear Boy chapters and optional ghost encounters before ending the episode, because the chapter completion locks in your result.
walkthrough.tip: Go to Sleep and Irritable Bowels require different outcomes, so use chapter replay to earn both.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Charley Mansfield during Sally Face Episode One

walkthroughMistakes: Entering a dream code before locating every clue.
Leaving the basement without checking Lost and Found for the Gear Boy cartridge.
Treating one conversation as final when new dialogue can unlock after discoveries.
checkpoints: Choose one tea outcome; the alternate Chapter One achievement needs a separate replay.
Pick up the Gear Boy, batteries, and basement cartridge before you close the case.
For The Unknown, inspect the morgue body, fifth-floor wall eye, and Larry's kitchen demon.

puzzles.title: Dream door code
puzzles.answer: The complete keypad code is 5364.

puzzles.title: Gear Boy route
puzzles.answer: Collect the device, batteries, basement cartridge, and finish every unlocked chapter.

puzzles.title: Charley's tea
puzzles.answer: Combine Addison tea with the sleeping aid or laxative, then give it to Charley.

items.name: Gear Boy
items.use: Detects supernatural activity and runs secret chapters

ending: Sal and Larry's improvised investigation exposes Charley's connection to Mrs. Sanderson's murder. The police remove Charley from Addison Apartments, but the supernatural sightings and the Gear Boy chapters make it clear that the case is only the surface of a much larger threat.

faqs.question: What is Sally Face Episode 1 called?
faqs.answer: Episode One is called Strange Neighbors.

faqs.question: What is the code in Sally Face Episode 1?
faqs.answer: The dream keypad code is 5364, assembled from four visual clues.

faqs.question: How long is Sally Face Episode 1?
faqs.answer: A first playthrough usually takes about 60–90 minutes; full achievement cleanup takes longer.

faqs.question: Can I earn every Episode 1 achievement in one run?
faqs.answer: No. Go to Sleep and Irritable Bowels use alternate tea outcomes, so chapter replay is required.

seo.title: Sally Face Chapter 1 Guide – Steps and Route
seo.description: Complete the Sally Face Chapter 1 walkthrough with the 5364 dream code, Gear Boy route, Charley tea outcomes, key items, missables and all seven achievements.

title: The Wretched
summary: A dark secret beneath the old apartments pulls Sal and Larry deeper into the supernatural mystery.
imageAlt: Sal Fisher and Larry Johnson walking through snow in Episode Two The Wretched
overview: Months after Charley's arrest, Sal's nightmares continue and Larry is convinced that something hostile lives inside Addison Apartments. The pair investigate disappearances, sealed rooms, and the history of the Addison family while the Super Gear Boy reveals fragments that normal sight cannot reach.

Episode Two rewards methodical backtracking. New dialogue appears after major discoveries, and several secrets require the crowbar, the puzzle-box chip, or a completed Super Gear Boy chapter before they can be resolved.

walkthrough.title: Catch up with Larry and inspect the building
walkthrough.body: Talk through every subject with Larry, revisit the apartments, and note locations that react to the Super Gear Boy. Search each floor before committing to the basement route.
walkthrough.tip: Best Buds requires every meaningful Larry dialogue option.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal and Larry outside in the Episode Two winter route

walkthrough.title: Find the four seals
walkthrough.body: Use the Super Gear Boy around Addison Apartments to reveal four occult seals. Clear the related spirit chapters as they appear so the Devour route remains complete.
walkthrough.tip: A strong Gear Boy reaction means a supernatural interaction is close, even if nothing is visible yet.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal encountering a supernatural presence in the Addison Apartments

walkthrough.title: Open the metal puzzle box
walkthrough.body: Get the missing puzzle-box piece from David's apartment, complete the required Gear Boy chapter, and transfer the recovered chip to Todd for analysis. Return to Larry after each step for the related dialogue.
walkthrough.tip: Do not ignore Chug's request; the reward connects to an optional game and later collectible path.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of a supernatural investigation scene in Episode Two

walkthrough.title: Enter the hidden apartment route
walkthrough.body: Use the crowbar to access 403 and speak with Mrs. Sanderson's ghost, then follow the basement clues toward apartment 2B. Finish all Super Gear Boy chapters before the final investigation sequence.
walkthrough.tip: Room 403 is easy to skip and is required for Unseen.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal in an underground investigation area

walkthroughMistakes: Skipping rooms that react to the Super Gear Boy.
Ignoring the puzzle-box follow-up before advancing the investigation.
Leaving room 403 unexplored after obtaining the crowbar.
checkpoints: Clear all four Super Gear Boy seals while Addison Apartments is still open.
Return to room 403 with the crowbar and speak with Mrs. Sanderson.
After the puzzle box, revisit Larry and bring the recovered chip to Todd.

puzzles.title: Four seals
puzzles.answer: Scan every floor with the Super Gear Boy and complete each revealed spirit encounter.

puzzles.title: Metal puzzle box
puzzles.answer: Recover the missing piece in David's apartment, solve the Gear Boy clue, then bring the chip to Todd.

puzzles.title: Apartment 2B
puzzles.answer: The concealed basement route opens after the supernatural chapters and related building clues are complete.

items.name: Super Gear Boy
items.use: Reveals spirit chapters and hidden pages

items.name: Computer chip
items.use: Allows Todd to decode the mystery

ending: The investigation confirms that the evil in Addison Apartments is organized rather than accidental. Sal and Larry uncover links between the building, the cult, and Larry's missing father, setting up the school investigation in Episode Three.

faqs.question: How many seals are in Episode 2?
faqs.answer: There are four seals to find for the Devour achievement.

faqs.question: How do I enter room 403?
faqs.answer: Obtain the crowbar and use it to break into the sealed apartment.

faqs.question: What should I do with the puzzle-box chip?
faqs.answer: Take the chip to Todd after opening the metal puzzle box.

faqs.question: Can I miss Super Gear Boy chapters?
faqs.answer: Yes. Search every floor before the final sequence and revisit rooms when the device reacts.

seo.title: Sally Face Chapter 2 Guide – Steps and Route
seo.description: Complete The Wretched with all four seals, Super Gear Boy chapters, the puzzle-box chip, room 403, hidden conversations and every Chapter 2 achievement.

title: The Bologna Incident
summary: A school lunch mystery leads the group to a gruesome discovery and a hidden cult operation.
imageAlt: Larry, Sal and Ashley reacting during Episode Three The Bologna Incident
overview: Episode Three expands the mystery beyond Addison Apartments. Suspicious cafeteria bologna, Mrs. Packerton's behavior, and fragments of Jim Johnson's journal push Sal, Larry, Ash, and Todd toward a hidden operation beneath Nockfell.

This is the most collectible-heavy early chapter. The timed prologue, eleven journal pages, optional Clumpy game, school conversations, and apartment backtracking all need attention before the final basement sequence.

walkthrough.title: Solve the timed journal prologue
walkthrough.body: Set the four symbol controls to top, bottom, top, and middle. In the white room, enter the six code groups while moving from right to left: 6269, 63, 663, 47, 96753, and 9687. Finishing both puzzles awards the journal route for Premonition.
walkthrough.tip: Pause between inputs if the countdown makes the two puzzles difficult to read.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal in the Episode Three white-room sequence

walkthrough.title: Investigate Nockfell High
walkthrough.body: Collect the paperclip, camera, sticky tack, and bologna sample. Photograph the bird for Kim, help Larry with the window distraction, and talk to Travis in the last bathroom stall using responses 3, 2, 3, 2.
walkthrough.tip: Keep the sticky tack instead of giving it away; it is needed for an optional collectible.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of the Nockfell High classroom investigation

walkthrough.title: Open Packerton's desk and Henry's computer
walkthrough.body: The classroom desk code is 3141, the first four digits of pi. Back at room 402, inspect the family clue and enter 491145 on Henry's computer—the alphabet positions for DIANE.
walkthrough.tip: These two codes unlock different branches; 3141 is the school desk, 491145 is the computer.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal, Larry, and Ashley investigating the school corridor

walkthrough.title: Collect all journal pages before the basement
walkthrough.body: Scan apartments with the Super Gear Boy, check the mailboxes and hidden temple room, resolve the puzzle-box follow-up, and collect all eleven journal pages. Do not take the final exit until page eleven has been read.
walkthrough.tip: Meeting in Todd's room and the late basement sequence act as practical points of no return.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Nockfell High before the late investigation route

walkthroughMistakes: Reading the timed white-room sequence in the wrong on-screen direction.
Using 3141 on Henry's computer instead of Mrs. Packerton's desk.
Reading 491145 as a date instead of the DIANE alphabet clue.
checkpoints: Finish the timed journal route before committing to the school investigation.
Use 3 → 2 → 3 → 2 with Travis and count all eleven journal pages.
Keep the two code locations straight: 3141 opens the desk; 491145 is for Henry's computer.

puzzles.title: Chapter 3 timed code
puzzles.answer: The white-room sequence is 9687 96753 47 663 63 6269; enter it from the rightmost group while moving left.

puzzles.title: Mrs. Packerton's desk
puzzles.answer: Enter 3141, the first four digits of pi.

puzzles.title: Henry's computer
puzzles.answer: Enter 491145, spelling DIANE through alphabet positions.

puzzles.title: Packerton apartment radio
puzzles.answer: Tune the radio to 104.7 to activate the clock clue.

puzzles.title: Packerton apartment clock
puzzles.answer: Set the clock to 12:12, following the goat's clue.

puzzles.title: Packerton freezer
puzzles.answer: Enter 1413 after comparing the blood marks with the board.

quickReferences.solution: Collect all 11 pages before leaving the chapter
quickReferences.caution: Check the journal count before the late basement sequence.

quickReferences.searchIntent: Sally Face Packerton desk code Henry computer password

ending: The group discovers the horrific source of the school bologna and confronts the cult operation beneath Nockfell. Their evidence proves that the conspiracy reaches further than the apartments, but the victory leaves the group facing consequences that reshape the following years.

faqs.answer: Mrs. Packerton's desk uses 3141.

faqs.answer: There are eleven pages required for Missing Pages.

title: The Trial
summary: The truth goes on trial as Sal revisits Addison Apartments and prepares for a final confrontation.
imageAlt: Sal Fisher walking through Todd's evidence-filled workshop in Episode Four The Trial
overview: Episode Four moves between testimony, memory, and the group's last investigation of Addison Apartments. Sal's account sounds impossible in court, but the playable flashback shows how carefully the friends prepared to destroy the corruption inside the building.

The chapter contains several strict collectibles: five teeth, nine VHS tapes, every resident conversation, and skill-based guitar sequences. Make a manual save before entering the final assault if you are pursuing all achievements.

walkthrough.title: Read Beelzebub's runes and enter 867
walkthrough.body: Visit gallery rooms one through three and count the lines in the paired symbols. The clue reads 7, 6, 8 in discovery order; reverse it at the keypad and enter 8, 6, 7. Record the six-symbol result found beyond the door for later.
walkthrough.tip: The rune value is the number of lines in the symbol, not its position on the wall: 768 is the clue, 867 is the usable door input.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of a distorted vision from the Episode Four investigation

walkthrough.title: Search every apartment for tapes and teeth
walkthrough.body: Speak to every resident, collect the pocket knife, and inspect rooms before moving floors. In room 502, cut open the bird cage and place the five teeth according to the inverted compass clue, with the black tooth in the center. For Brothers, inspect the mattress in room 504, leave the room, return, inspect it again, and check the noose three times.
walkthrough.tip: The Made in China sticker is upside down, so invert north/south and east/west when placing the teeth.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Episode Four screenshot of the nine-tape VHS archive

walkthrough.title: Open the floor panel with 435542
walkthrough.body: Use the knife on the suspicious panel in apartment 201. Convert the six runes from Beelzebub's fourth room by counting their lines; enter 435542 to recover the OTHERS VHS tape.
walkthrough.tip: The 435542 panel code is separate from the gallery door's usable 867 input.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of the numbered wall panel used during the investigation

walkthrough.title: Complete the guitar and Endless One sequences
walkthrough.body: During the assault, switch characters deliberately and play each guitar pattern without a missed note. From the roof down, the barrier patterns are 2-6-11; 1-5-8-9; 3-7-1-9-10; 4-7-9-7-10-6-3; and 10-6-9-5-10-6-3-8-2. Collect all remaining tapes before entering 103 and beginning the final confrontation with Terrence Addison.
walkthrough.tip: Dark Melodies and Destroyer fail after a missed input; restart from a save instead of continuing.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of the dark final assault against the Endless One

walkthroughMistakes: Using a normal north-up compass for the bird cage.
Entering the discovery-order 768 instead of the usable 867 gallery-door input.
Forgetting to record the six-rune clue that becomes 435542.
checkpoints: Use 867 at the gallery door; 768 is the clue order, not the keypad input.
Collect all nine VHS tapes and five teeth before entering room 103.
A missed guitar note prevents Dark Melodies or Destroyer on that attempt.

puzzles.answer: Invert the compass because the label is upside down; place the black tooth in the center.

puzzles.title: Apartment floor panel
puzzles.answer: Enter 435542 to recover the OTHERS tape.

quickReferences.clue: Count lines in the paired symbols in gallery rooms one through three. The clue is 768 in discovery order; enter the result from the bottom of the keypad.
quickReferences.caution: 768 is the clue order; enter 867 at the door.

quickReferences.caution: This opens the OTHERS tape route; it is not the gallery-door code.

quickReferences.caution: Room 103 is the point of no return for the archive.

title: Memories and Dreams
summary: The past returns as Ash, Larry, Todd and Sal fight to stop the darkness surrounding Nockfell.
imageAlt: Official Episode Five Memories and Dreams artwork showing Sal Fisher's mask in dark grass
overview: The final episode follows the surviving friends across years, dimensions, and memories as they attempt to undo the cult's victory. Character switching, different visual forms, and combat-like sequences replace the apartment investigation rhythm of earlier chapters.

Completion depends on preparation. Read every note, exhaust the dialogue of the three voices, recover all color pieces, and avoid every game over if you want the full achievement set. The Epilogue also checks completion from Episodes One through Four.

walkthrough.title: Search Ash's home before leaving
walkthrough.body: Read Todd's notes, exhaust Neil's dialogue, search the bathroom for the white color piece, and inspect every highlighted object before approaching Sal's grave.
walkthrough.tip: Escaping Death spans the whole Chapter. If a game-over screen appears, start a fresh clean Chapter run.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of the Episode Five cemetery approach

walkthrough.title: Open the shed with 4035364
walkthrough.body: Use the remembered code 4035364 on the shed. It combines the murder-scene room number with the Episode One dream code and unlocks the route needed for Memorized.
walkthrough.tip: 403 + 5364 is the logic behind the seven-digit combination.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of the Episode Five shed route

walkthrough.title: Collect the color pieces and unlock room five
walkthrough.body: Explore every playable perspective and recover all six color pieces. In the smooth-cartoon house, use 1-1-1-1-1-2-2-3 on the hexagons, then add 5023, 7842, and 145 to enter 13010. Activate the pyramids with 132123, 313221311, and 231332123213; use 1-1-2-2-3-3 for the polygon arrows and 1-2-3-3 for the painting. In claymation, open the safe with 1983, then enter the colors white, black, blue, red, green, and purple at door five.
walkthrough.tip: The DOG route is lore-critical, not just a collectible detour.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of an Episode Five puzzle interface

walkthrough.title: Survive the final multi-form battle
walkthrough.body: Follow each character's objective: evade detection as Ash, destroy the marked enemies as Larry, and clear the orb and tentacle phases in Sal's changing forms. Preserve health and avoid hazards to keep Escaping Death valid.
walkthrough.tip: Read all notes and finish optional dialogue before entering the central chamber.
walkthrough.imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal during the Episode Five final battle

walkthroughMistakes: Adding a separator between 403 and 5364 at the shed keypad.
Leaving the shed before the Memorized route registers.
Entering the final sequence before reading notes and finishing optional conversations.
checkpoints: Read every note and collect all six color pieces before door five.
Enter 4035364 as one number at the shed.
For Escaping Death, begin a fresh clean Chapter run after any game over; Epilogue also needs Chapters One through Four complete.

puzzles.title: Polygon arrows and painting
puzzles.answer: Use 1-1-2-2-3-3 for the arrows and 1-2-3-3 for the painting.

puzzles.title: Claymation safe
puzzles.answer: Enter 1983, the initiation year found in the nearby notes.

puzzles.title: DOG color pieces
puzzles.answer: At door five, enter white, black, blue, red, green, then purple.

puzzles.title: Clay console
puzzles.answer: Set the sliders to 3, 1, 2 and the switches to down, up, down.

quickReferences.title: Todd's smooth-cartoon room
quickReferences.clue: Add the three visible values: 145, 5023 and 7842.
quickReferences.caution: Enter the sum as one five-digit code.

quickReferences.title: Three pyramid inputs
quickReferences.clue: Each pyramid follows the directional note for its area; use the complete sequence before placing the piece.
quickReferences.caution: Finish every pyramid before leaving the smooth-cartoon route.

quickReferences.title: DOG color-door route
quickReferences.clue: Recover every color piece across the episode, then use them at door five in the Void.
quickReferences.solution: White → black → blue → red → green → purple
quickReferences.caution: The color pieces are also required for the DOG achievement.

quickReferences.title: Deathless completion
quickReferences.clue: This achievement checks the entire chapter, across Ash, Larry and Sal's danger sequences.
quickReferences.solution: Finish Chapter Five without a game-over screen
quickReferences.caution: A game over ends the clean attempt; begin a fresh Chapter run before trying again.
